pages.text: Bring two Quantum Computers, one Essence of Entanglement, and one charged $(l:qcraft:computers/coolant)Coolant Cell$(/l). Pair the computers before placing them.
pages.title: Gather the Computers

pages.text: For eight bases, bring eight Essences of Observation, eight Gold Blocks, and 40 Obsidian. Also bring two different ordinary blocks as cargo, such as Gold Block and Diamond Block.
pages.title: Gather the Pylons
Two Matching Stations
pages.text: Top view. Colored corners mark the cargo.
On open ground in one dimension, put the computers 12 blocks apart east to west. Place a $(l:qcraft:computers/pylons)pylon base$(/l) two blocks out along each arm. Use one-block-high pylons.
pages.title: Place the Stations

pages.text: Each interior is 3×3 at computer height. Place one cargo block diagonally southeast of each computer. Keep all other interior cells empty. Stay close enough to load both stations.
pages.title: Add Test Cargo

pages.text: Insert coolant at either station and click Energize. Check that the marked cargo traded places, the centers stayed put, and the cell lost one charge. See $(l:qcraft:computers/status)status messages$(/l) if needed.
pages.title: Energize
